test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

A. Lying in bed waiting

B. For the postman to bring

C. Him news of a legacy

D. Luck keeps on
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with "Luck keeps on," which is correctly indicated by **part (D).**
 
• Following this, "lying in bed waiting" **(A)** logically continues the sequence, describing the action that luck finds the person doing.
 
• **The next part,** "for the postman to bring" **(B)** continues with what the person is waiting for.
 
• **Ending with** "him news of a legacy" **(C)** completes the sentence by stating what the postman is expected to bring.

Therefore, the correct answer is **DABC.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (BDAC):** This option starts with "for the postman to bring lying in bed waiting," which disrupts the logical flow of the sentence.
 
• **Option 3 (BDCA):** This option starts with "for the postman to bring him news of a legacy," which misses out on the original focus and sequence of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4 (ADBC):** This option starts with "lying in bed waiting luck keeps on," which makes the sentence grammatically incorrect and confusing.
